chain_focus: Google TPU v8t (training) generation — the training-optimized v8 SKU with high HBM4 capacity and heavy optical/OCS scale-up interconnect. Host CPU migrates from x86 to custom Arm Axion 2. From fab tools and HBM4 through TSMC fabrication, Broadcom co-design and CoWoS packaging to OCS-interconnected training pods serving Google DeepMind (Gemini training) and Anthropic. Generation- and workload-separated from TPU v7 (Ironwood) and the inference SKU TPU v8i.

players.product: Gemini frontier-model training on TPU v8t
Claude model training on TPU v8t
TPU v8t training pods (OCS-interconnected) in Google Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: At Cloud Next, Google introduced its 8th-generation TPUs, individually specialized for training vs serving. TPU 8t (training) provides ~3x the processing of Ironwood (TPU v7) and 2x the performance, built for the most demanding agentic training workloads.

players.product: TPU v8t training-pod system boards & racks

quarterly_data.signal: Strengthening 2027 outlook from two next-generation hyperscaler AI/ML compute programs ramping in 2027 plus a 'digital native' fully-integrated compute+networking rack-scale program entering production in 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: next-gen compute programs + digital-native rack ramping 2027

quarterly_data.signal: 2027 enterprise growth to be driven by the ramp of MULTIPLE next-generation AI/ML compute programs (ramps in the half of 2027); AI/ML compute demand 'significantly increased' vs 90 days ago for 2026 and into 2027. Capacity is in place for 2027 demand — the constraint is material (some component lead times well above 52 weeks); customers placed non-cancellable, non-refundable orders for long-lead silicon.
quarterly_data.figure: multiple next-gen AI/ML compute programs ramping 2027; demand > guided revenue
